# ContentOS Agent Lite

> Open-source **AI content agent for founders** that writes from a verifiable **process, not a prompt**:
> 7 gates (context → sources → brief → draft → checks → uplift → publish), scoring every draft 0–100
> across 8 axes, locally. Runs in Claude Code / Cursor / Codex with zero API keys; sharper with a free
> research key. A transparent, free, self-hosted alternative to one-shot AI writers. Scores EN + RU + AR
> content. By Humanswith.ai. MIT.

## What it is
- A portable `content-agent/` folder of 7 gate files (`00`–`07`) the founder's coding agent follows.
- An optional Python layer: `research` (Tavily/Firecrawl/Serper + no-key fallback), `score`
  (transparent 8-axis AEO/quality heuristic, 0–100), `check` (anti-slop, EN/RU/AR).
- Hard rule: no draft before context/research/source-pack/brief pass; a fact without a source is a stop.

## How it differs from one-shot AI writers
- Produces text via a 7-gate process (sources → brief → draft → checks), not one prompt → one draft.
- A fact without a source is a hard stop, so it does not confidently make things up.
- The 0–100 quality score is transparent (readable code), not a black box. Free, MIT, runs in your IDE.

## FAQ
- Is it free? Yes — MIT, open-source; bring your own free-tier keys, or run with no keys.
- Do I need an API key? No; inside Claude Code/Cursor/Codex the agent is the model.
- Does it guarantee rankings? No. It improves grounding, structure, and citability — not positions.
- How is it different from hosted ContentOS? Lite is the open-source skeleton; the hosted product adds
  per-engine AEO, KG+NLI+deep fact-check, best-of-N judge tournament, EN/RU/AR, team scale, hosting.

## Honest scope
- A skeleton of a content process, not a full platform; no ranking guarantees, no learning loop.
- Managed version (per-engine AEO, deep fact-check, best-of-N, EN/RU/AR, teams): https://humanswith.ai/platform/contentos/
